Good local Da Nang & regional Quang Nam dishes
Aug 2026 • Friends
We had local Da Nang dishes like Bún Thịt Nướng (Grilled Pork Vermicelli), Bánh Canh Tôm + Trứng Cút (Mini Pancakes with Shrimp & Quail Egg), and Chả Giò Truyền Thống (traditional fried spring rolls with pork). We also had regional Quang Nam province dishes like Mì Quảng Tôm Thịt (Quang Noodles with Shrimp & Pork). Everything was good, even though the restaurant specialises in Cơm Tấm (broken rice), which is a Saigon dish. There's an air conditioned space and the place is clean. Service was brisk and cards are accepted here.

Fantastic and Inexpensive Rice Plates
Jan 2023
I have eaten here twice in the last week. Try the pork chop rice plate, and if you're hungry, a chicken thigh and leg quarter on the side. The plate comes with soup, broken rice, a few vegetable slices, pickled daikon and carrot, and nuoc cham sauce! The meat is perfectly cooked...the pork chop marinated and grilled, and the chicken with crispy skin but rich and buttery flesh. The owner takes pride in her restaurant and even has her picture painted on the wall. The location is great, too!
